content.title: WEIRD BODY SIGNALS MOST PEOPLE BLAME ON {{STRESS}}
facts: **Iodine** – Unexplained weight gain, constant fatigue, dry skin, and a swollen neck or throat.
**Vitamin K** – Easy bruising, cuts that won't stop bleeding, and bleeding gums.
**Folate** – Pale skin, irritability, shortness of breath, and a swollen or sore tongue.
**Vitamin A** – Night blindness, dry eyes, frequent infections, and rough, bumpy skin on the arms.
**Vitamin E** – Muscle weakness, poor balance and coordination, and numbness in the hands or feet.
**Potassium** – Muscle cramps, heart palpitations, constipation, and persistent fatigue.
**Zinc** – Slow wound healing, loss of taste or smell, frequent colds, and thinning hair.
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
A swollen neck isn't always 'just your thyroid acting up' — low iodine makes the thyroid gland physically enlarge as it struggles to produce enough hormone, which is why that pressure in your throat can be the first real clue. Bruising way too easily from tiny bumps often points to low vitamin K, since your body needs it to activate the proteins that actually form a blood clot. And that constant pale, washed-out, breathless feeling people chalk up to 'just being tired' can trace back to low folate, which your body needs to make healthy red blood cells that carry oxygen efficiently. Everyone's body is different, so use these as a starting point, not a diagnosis.
